```{python}
# Reads analysis/precision.py's TSVs from $PRECISION_RESULTS (default ../results/precision).
# Render: analysis/precision.py renders it at the end, or
#   PRECISION_RESULTS=<dir> quarto render report/precision.qmd --output-dir <dir>
import base64
import html
import io
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from matplotlib.patches import Patch

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("../analysis").resolve()))
import figures as fg  # omnicol and the shared figure style
import precision as pr  # tolerances and names

R = Path(os.environ.get("PRECISION_RESULTS", "../results/precision"))


def tsv(name):
    p = R / f"precision_{name}.tsv"
    return pd.read_csv(p, sep="\t", dtype={"res_key": str}) if p.exists() else pd.DataFrame()


folders, pairs, agree, acc, cost = (tsv(n) for n in ("folders", "pairs", "agreement", "accuracy", "cost"))
if not len(agree):
    raise RuntimeError(f"no precision_agreement.tsv in {R}: run analysis/precision.py first")

CROSS, FLOOR = fg.OMNICOL[0], "#9a9995"
FLAG = "#b82033"
LEVEL = {"pca": "PCA", "knn": "kNN", "cluster": "Leiden"}
MEASURE = {"pca_agreement": "PCA agreement", "knn_shared": "shared neighbours", "ari": "ARI", "jaccard": "Jaccard"}
NAMED = list(pr.p2.PIPELINES)
datasets = sorted(agree["dataset"].unique())


def raw(s):
    print(f"\n```{{=html}}\n{s}\n```\n")


def show(fig):
    buf = io.BytesIO()
    fig.savefig(buf, format="png", dpi=85)
    plt.close(fig)
    raw(f'<img src="data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()}" style="max-width:100%">')


def table(df, digits=3, title="Table", flags=()):
    """A DataFrame as an HTML table folded under a summary; `flags` columns in red where True."""
    def cell(c, v):
        if c in flags:
            return '<td class="flag">yes</td>' if v is True or v == "True" else "<td>no</td>" if v in (False, "False") else "<td>—</td>"
        if isinstance(v, (float, np.floating)):
            return "<td>—</td>" if not np.isfinite(v) else f"<td>{v:.{digits}f}</td>"
        return f"<td>{html.escape(str(v))}</td>"
    head = "".join(f"<th>{html.escape(str(c))}</th>" for c in df.columns)
    body = "".join("<tr>" + "".join(cell(c, v) for c, v in zip(df.columns, row)) + "</tr>"
                   for row in df.itertuples(index=False))
    raw(f'<details><summary>{html.escape(title)}</summary><div class="tbl"><table><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead>'
        f'<tbody>{body}</tbody></table></div></details>')


def order(groups):
    g = list(dict.fromkeys(groups))
    return [x for x in NAMED if x in g] + sorted(x for x in g if x not in NAMED)


def flagged(s):
    return s.astype(str) == "True"


def agreement_boxes(p, flags, ylabel):
    """Per dataset: per group, the cross pairs (colour) beside the replicate floor (grey), every
    pair a point, all sizes together; a group whose cross median is beyond noise at any size is
    labelled in red (`flags`: (dataset, group) pairs)."""
    if not len(p):
        print("\n_Nothing to show here._\n")
        return
    groups = order(p["group"])
    fl = set(flags)
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(min(18, max(6.5, 0.75 * len(groups) * len(datasets) + 2)), 3.6),
                             sharey=True, constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        sub = p[p["dataset"] == d]
        for i, g in enumerate(groups):
            for j, (kind, col) in enumerate((("cross", CROSS), ("floor", FLOOR))):
                v = sub[(sub["group"] == g) & sub["kind"].str.startswith(kind)]["value"].dropna().to_numpy()
                if not len(v):
                    continue
                pos = i - 0.18 + 0.36 * j
                ax.boxplot([v], positions=[pos], widths=0.3, patch_artist=True, showfliers=False,
                           medianprops={"color": col, "lw": 1.6}, boxprops={"facecolor": col + "33", "edgecolor": col},
                           whiskerprops={"color": col}, capprops={"color": col})
                ax.scatter(pos + rng.uniform(-0.1, 0.1, len(v)), v, s=7, color=col, alpha=0.7, zorder=3, linewidths=0)
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(groups)), groups, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=7)
        for lab in ax.get_xticklabels():
            if (d, lab.get_text()) in fl:
                lab.set_color(FLAG)
                lab.set_fontweight("bold")
        ax.set_title(d, loc="left")
        ax.grid(axis="x", visible=False)
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    fig.legend(handles=[Patch(facecolor=CROSS + "33", edgecolor=CROSS, label="float32 vs float64"),
                        Patch(facecolor=FLOOR + "33", edgecolor=FLOOR, label="replicates (floor)")],
               loc="outside right center", frameon=False, fontsize=7)
    show(fig)


# oracle resolution of each float64 pipeline: the Leiden comparisons are shown there
oracle = acc[acc["res_key"] == "oracle"][["dataset", "subsample", "group", "resolution_float64"]] if len(acc) else pd.DataFrame()


def at_oracle(t):
    if not len(oracle):
        return t
    m = t.merge(oracle, on=["dataset", "subsample", "group"], how="inner")
    return m[np.isclose(m["resolution"], m["resolution_float64"])].drop(columns=["resolution_float64"])


FLAGGED = {}
for (lv, ms), g in agree.groupby(["level", "measure"]):
    g = at_oracle(g) if lv == "cluster" else g
    FLAGGED[(lv, ms)] = list(zip(g.loc[flagged(g["beyond_noise"]), "dataset"],
                                               g.loc[flagged(g["beyond_noise"]), "group"]))
```

```{python}
#| output: asis
tags = ", ".join(f"`{r.folder}` ({r.precision})" for r in folders.itertuples())
n = folders.groupby("precision").size()
print(f"**Folders:** {tags}.\n")
print(f"**Replicates:** {n.get('float64', 0)} float64, {n.get('float32', 0)} float32. Only the PCA computes in the "
      f"chosen precision; kNN and Leiden keep their own (sklearn, leidenalg and igraph in float64; pynndescent, "
      f"cuML and cuGraph in float32), so everything downstream changes only through the embedding.\n")

lines = []
for lv in ("pca", "knn", "cluster"):
    g = agree[agree["level"] == lv]
    g = at_oracle(g) if lv == "cluster" else g
    if not len(g):
        continue
    f = g[flagged(g["beyond_noise"])]
    which = ", ".join(sorted({f"{r.group} ({MEASURE[r.measure]})" if lv == "cluster" else r.group
                              for r in f.itertuples()})) or "none"
    lines.append(f"- **{LEVEL[lv]}:** {len(f)} of {len(g)} comparisons beyond replicate noise: {which}.")
if len(acc):
    a = acc[acc["res_key"] == "oracle"]
    f = a[flagged(a["ari_beyond_noise"]) | flagged(a["jaccard_beyond_noise"])]
    lines.append(f"- **Accuracy at the oracle resolution:** {len(f)} of {len(a)} pipeline × dataset × size "
                 f"medians moved beyond noise" + (": " + ", ".join(sorted(set(f["group"]))) if len(f) else "") + ".")
if len(cost):
    f = cost[flagged(cost["wall_s_beyond_noise"])]
    lines.append(f"- **Wall time:** {len(f)} of {len(cost)} job medians moved beyond noise"
                 + (": " + ", ".join(sorted({f'{r.module} ×{r.wall_s_ratio:.2f}' for r in f.itertuples()})) if len(f) else "") + ".")
print("## Summary\n\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n")
raw(f"""<details><summary>How “beyond noise” is decided</summary><div class="metric">
<p>Every result is paired with its counterpart: the same modules, settings and seeds, computed with the
other PCA precision (<b>cross</b>). The <b>floor</b> is the same comparison between same-seed replicates of
one precision: what rerunning alone changes. A deterministic module has a floor of exactly 1.</p>
<ul>
<li><b>Agreement</b> (PCA agreement, shared neighbours, ARI, Jaccard): beyond noise when the cross median is
below the floor's lower quartile by more than {pr.TOL:g}.</li>
<li><b>Accuracy</b> (ARI and Jaccard against the labels, number of clusters): Δ = median float32 − median
float64; beyond noise when |Δ| exceeds both {pr.TOL:g} (half a cluster for the count) and the largest spread
of per-folder medians within either precision.</li>
<li><b>Cost</b> (wall time, CPU time, peak memory, warm jobs): ratio = median float32 / median float64; beyond
noise when it is further from 1 than both ×{pr.COST_TOL:g} and the largest max/min ratio of per-folder medians
within either precision.</li>
</ul>
<p>The tolerances are the deck's dominance tolerances (δ<sub>s</sub> = {pr.TOL:g}, δ<sub>c</sub> = log {pr.COST_TOL:g}).
Leiden comparisons are shown at each pipeline's float64 oracle resolution; the tables hold every resolution.</p>
</div></details>""")
```

## PCA

How much of the float64 embedding's variance the float32 embedding's subspace holds, for every PCA
module and seed. Exact solvers should sit at 1; randomized solvers can move further, since a
float32 matrix changes their iterations.

```{python}
#| output: asis
agreement_boxes(pairs[pairs["level"] == "pca"], FLAGGED.get(("pca", "pca_agreement"), []), "PCA agreement")
cols = ["dataset", "subsample", "group", "cross_median", "cross_min", "floor_median", "gap", "beyond_noise"]
table(agree[agree["level"] == "pca"][cols], 4, "PCA agreement, per dataset and size", flags=("beyond_noise",))
```

## kNN

Shared neighbours per cell between the float32 and float64 graphs. The kNN modules compute in
their own precision either way: any change comes from the embedding they were given.

```{python}
#| output: asis
agreement_boxes(pairs[pairs["level"] == "knn"], FLAGGED.get(("knn", "knn_shared"), []), "shared neighbours")
table(agree[agree["level"] == "knn"][cols], 4, "Shared neighbours, per dataset and size", flags=("beyond_noise",))
```

## Leiden

The final clusters of every pipeline, float32 against float64, at the pipeline's float64 oracle
resolution.

```{python}
#| output: asis
lp = at_oracle(pairs[pairs["level"] == "cluster"])
for ms in ("ari", "jaccard"):
    print(f"\n### {MEASURE[ms]}\n")
    agreement_boxes(lp[lp["measure"] == ms], FLAGGED.get(("cluster", ms), []), MEASURE[ms])
c = agree[(agree["level"] == "cluster")]
table(c[["measure", "dataset", "subsample", "group", "resolution", "cross_median", "cross_min", "floor_median", "gap",
         "beyond_noise"]], 4, "Every pipeline and resolution", flags=("beyond_noise",))
```

## Accuracy

Does float32 move accuracy against the labels? Δ = median float32 − median float64 at each
precision's own oracle resolution, one point per dataset and size. The grey bar is the noise:
± the largest spread of per-folder medians within a precision.

```{python}
#| output: asis
def delta_plot(a, m, ylabel):
    a = a[a["res_key"] == "oracle"]
    if not len(a):
        print("\n_Nothing to show here._\n")
        return
    groups = order(a["group"])
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(datasets), figsize=(min(18, max(6.5, 0.6 * len(groups) * len(datasets) + 2)), 3.4),
                             sharey=True, constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    for ax, d in zip(axes[0], datasets):
        sub = a[a["dataset"] == d]
        sizes = sorted(sub["subsample"].unique())
        for i, g in enumerate(groups):
            for j, s in enumerate(sizes):
                r = sub[(sub["group"] == g) & (sub["subsample"] == s)]
                if not len(r):
                    continue
                r = r.iloc[0]
                x = i - 0.25 + 0.5 * (j + 0.5) / len(sizes)
                nz = r[f"{m}_noise"]
                if np.isfinite(nz):
                    ax.plot([x, x], [-nz, nz], color=FLOOR, lw=4, alpha=0.4, solid_capstyle="butt")
                fl = str(r[f"{m}_beyond_noise"]) == "True"
                ax.scatter([x], [r[f"{m}_delta"]], s=18, color=FLAG if fl else CROSS, zorder=3)
        ax.axhline(0, color="#555", lw=0.8)
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(groups)), groups, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=7)
        ax.set_title(d, loc="left")
        ax.grid(axis="x", visible=False)
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    show(fig)


delta_plot(acc, "ari", "Δ ARI (float32 − float64)")
delta_plot(acc, "jaccard", "Δ Jaccard (float32 − float64)")
table(acc[["dataset", "subsample", "group", "res_key", "resolution_float64", "resolution_float32",
           "ari_float64", "ari_float32", "ari_delta", "ari_noise", "ari_beyond_noise",
           "jaccard_delta", "jaccard_beyond_noise", "n_clusters_float64", "n_clusters_float32",
           "n_clusters_beyond_noise"]], 4, "Accuracy and number of clusters, every resolution",
      flags=("ari_beyond_noise", "jaccard_beyond_noise", "n_clusters_beyond_noise"))
```

## Cost

What float32 saves: the warm median of every job, float32 / float64, one point per dataset and
size (log scale; below 1 is cheaper). The grey bar spans the noise, the largest max/min ratio of
per-folder medians within a precision.

```{python}
#| output: asis
def ratio_plot(col, ylabel):
    if not len(cost):
        print("\n_Nothing to show here._\n")
        return
    stages = [s for s in ("pca", "knn", "cluster") if s in set(cost["stage"])]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(stages), figsize=(min(18, 4.5 * len(stages)), 3.4), sharey=True,
                             constrained_layout=True, squeeze=False)
    for ax, st in zip(axes[0], stages):
        sub = cost[cost["stage"] == st]
        mods = sorted(sub["module"].unique())
        for i, m in enumerate(mods):
            rs_ = sub[sub["module"] == m].reset_index(drop=True)
            for j, r in rs_.iterrows():
                x = i - 0.3 + 0.6 * (j + 0.5) / len(rs_)
                nz = r[f"{col}_noise"]
                if np.isfinite(nz) and nz > 0:
                    ax.plot([x, x], [1 / nz, nz], color=FLOOR, lw=4, alpha=0.4, solid_capstyle="butt")
                fl = str(r[f"{col}_beyond_noise"]) == "True"
                if np.isfinite(r[f"{col}_ratio"]) and r[f"{col}_ratio"] > 0:
                    ax.scatter([x], [r[f"{col}_ratio"]], s=18, color=FLAG if fl else CROSS, zorder=3)
        ax.axhline(1, color="#555", lw=0.8)
        for y in (pr.COST_TOL, 1 / pr.COST_TOL):
            ax.axhline(y, color="#555", lw=0.6, ls=":")
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(mticker.LogLocator(subs=(1.0, 2.0, 5.0)))
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(lambda v, _: f"{v:g}"))
        ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())
        ax.set_xticks(range(len(mods)), mods, rotation=30, ha="right", fontsize=7)
        ax.set_title(LEVEL[st], loc="left")
        ax.grid(axis="x", visible=False)
    axes[0][0].set_ylabel(ylabel)
    show(fig)


for col, lab in pr.COST.items():
    print(f"\n### {lab[0].upper() + lab[1:]}\n")
    ratio_plot(col, f"float32 / float64, {lab}")
table(cost, 3, "Every job median", flags=tuple(c for c in cost.columns if c.endswith("beyond_noise")))
```
